queries: WITH votes AS (SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote), country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM votes AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, ABS(avg_points_won - AVG(avg_points_won) OVER ()) AS distance_from_group_average FROM country_averages;
